content: OWASP LLM01:2025 and Microsoft's Spotlighting research (arXiv 2403.14720) recommend structured prompt templates with explicit delimiters isolating untrusted user input from system instructions; Spotlighting cut indirect injection success from >50% to <2% on GPT-family models without a library, purely via prompt structure (delimiting/datamarking/encoding) - now used in production in Azure Prompt Shields.
